description: 5.foo_bar_baz is a made-up method name -- Integer has no such method, so this really does raise NoMethodError when run. Permanent negative target, and the pair to unmodeled-builtin-zero-p: same shape, one real method and one not, so a checker cannot pass both by being generous about unknown selectors.
